author: DJI
description:
Featuring touchscreen subject selection with the new Enhanced Intelligent Tracking Module, enabling precise tracking of people, vehicles, pets, and custom subjects. All-axis fine-tuning knobs deliver smooth, accurate balancing, while the Electronic Briefcase Handle offers direct, intuitive control for more creative angles. Faster charging and extended battery life keep creativity moving, turning ambition into cinematic results.

Key features of the DJI RS 5:
✅ Enhanced Intelligent Tracking and Composition
✅ Briefcase Handle With Gimbal & Camera Control
✅ 1-Hour Full Charge, 15% Extended Runtime
✅ Fine-Tuning Knobs and Teflon™ Enhanced Balancing
✅ 2nd-Gen Automated Axis Locks
✅ New Z-Axis Indicator

Learn more：https://brnw.ch/21wZtHj
Buy now：https://brnw.ch/21wZtHn

*The Enhanced Intelligent Tracking Module and Electronic Briefcase Handle are available for separate purchase or as part of a compatible combo.
*The DJI RS BG33 Battery Grip is not available for purchase in India. 

#DJI #D
